fields.name: dwSize
fields.description: The total size of the returned structure in bytes (that is, not usually the size of the SIMCONNECT_RECV structure, but of the structure that inherits it).

fields.name: dwVersion
fields.description: The version number of the SimConnect server.

fields.name: dwID
fields.description: The ID of the returned structure. One member of SIMCONNECT_RECV_ID.

fields.name: dwRequestID
fields.description: The ID of the client defined request.

fields.name: dwObjectID
fields.description: The ID of the client defined object.

fields.name: dwDefineID
fields.description: The ID of the client defined data definition.

fields.name: dwFlags
fields.description: The flags that were set for this data request, see SimConnect_RequestDataOnSimObject for a description of the flags. This parameter will always be set to zero if the call was SimConnect_RequestDataOnSimObjectType.

fields.name: dwentrynumber
fields.description: If multiple objects are being returned, this is the index number of this object out of a total of dwoutof. This will always be 1 if the call was SimConnect_RequestDataOnSimObject, and can be 0 or more if the call was SimConnect_RequestDataOnSimObjectType.

fields.name: dwoutof
fields.description: The total number of objects being returned. Note that dwentrynumber and dwoutof start with 1 not 0, so if two objects are being returned dwentrynumber and dwoutof pairs will be 1,2 and 2,2 for the two objects. This will always be 1 if the call was SimConnect_RequestDataOnSimObject, and can be 0 or more if the call was SimConnect_RequestDataOnSimObjectType.

fields.name: dwDefineCount
fields.description: The number of 8-byte elements in the dwData array.

fields.name: dwData
fields.description: A data array containing information on a specified object in 8-byte (double word) elements. The length of the array is dwDefineCount.

fields.name: dwException
fields.description: One member of the SIMCONNECT_EXCEPTION enumeration type, indicating which error has occurred.

fields.name: dwSendID
fields.description: The ID of the packet that contained the error, see Remarks below.

fields.name: dwIndex
fields.description: The index number (starting at 1) of the first parameter that caused an error. Special case: UNKNOWN_INDEX = 0.

fields.name: Latitude
fields.description: Latitude in degrees.

fields.name: Longitude
fields.description: Longitude in degrees.

fields.name: Altitude
fields.description: Altitude in feet.

fields.name: Pitch
fields.description: Pitch in degrees.

fields.name: Bank
fields.description: Bank in degrees.

fields.name: Heading
fields.description: Heading in degrees.

fields.name: OnGround
fields.description: Set this to 1 to place the object on the ground, or 0 if the object is to be airborne.

fields.name: Airspeed
fields.description: The airspeed in knots, or one of the following special values: INITPOSITION_AIRSPEED_CRUISE (-1): The aircraft's design cruising speed. INITPOSITION_AIRSPEED_KEEP (-2): Maintain the current airspeed.

fields.description: Longitude in degrees.
